transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started on the maintenance board for the next workday. We've got four work orders to schedule: vehicle V-17, generator G-2, communications shelter UPS-3, and support vehicle CH-4. The workday runs 0800 to 1600, and each item needs a scheduled window and a responsible section assigned. Available sections are Motor Pool, Power Section, Signal Shop, and Support Equipment Cell. Before I sign the board, I need each section to confirm their updates during this huddle. Let's hear from each of you -- what are you bringing to the table for these work orders?
